claims.Finding: For count0 the function zeroes the six-float output. Otherwise it initializes lower=(x-radius,y-height,z-radius) and upper=(x+radius,y+height,z+radius) from the first40-byte record after a24-byte header. For every later record, it uses MINSS at40ACF0/40AD01/40AD14 for lower coordinates and also MINSS at40AD27/40AD39/40AD50 for upper coordinates. It does not compute an enclosing union of arbitrary multiple finite records. The original three-body native probe reproduces this for12 synthetic cases, including separated centers0 and100 with radius1 producing x[-1,1] rather than[-1,101].
claims.Limitations: Native probe inputs are finite, dimensions nonnegative and counts0..3. This is not a claim of malformed retail data, current player reachability, all-input floating-point behavior, or a proven gameplay defect. The intended wider engine contract is not fully established.
